evidence.heading: Evidence checklist
evidence.summary: You marked {available} items as available. {required} items are important for this pack.

vehicle_photos.name: Photos of the vehicle damage
vehicle_photos.description: Include close views and the wider scene where possible.

vehicle_police_report.name: Police or incident report
vehicle_police_report.description: Keep the report or reference number if one exists.

vehicle_insurance_details.name: Insurance details
vehicle_insurance_details.description: Keep the policy, claim number, and insurer messages together.

vehicle_repair_estimate.name: Repair estimate
vehicle_repair_estimate.description: Use an estimate or invoice that shows the expected cost.

vehicle_registration.name: Vehicle registration
vehicle_registration.description: Keep a readable copy of the current registration.

vehicle_driver_license.name: Driver licence
vehicle_driver_license.description: Keep a readable copy for the driver involved.

property_photos.name: Photos of the property damage
property_photos.description: Capture each affected area before cleanup where possible.

property_ownership.name: Ownership or tenancy document
property_ownership.description: Use the record that connects you to the damaged property.

property_damage_report.name: Damage report
property_damage_report.description: Keep any building, emergency, or contractor report.

property_insurance_policy.name: Property insurance policy
property_insurance_policy.description: Keep the relevant policy pages and claim reference.

property_repair_quotes.name: Repair quotes
property_repair_quotes.description: Collect clear estimates for the work that is needed.

property_correspondence.name: Messages with the responsible party
property_correspondence.description: Keep relevant emails, letters, or message records.

injury_medical_records.name: Medical records
injury_medical_records.description: Keep treatment notes, discharge papers, and summaries.

injury_incident_report.name: Incident report
injury_incident_report.description: Keep the report that records when and how the injury happened.

injury_witness_statements.name: Witness details
injury_witness_statements.description: Keep names, contact details, and any written statements.

injury_expense_receipts.name: Expense receipts
injury_expense_receipts.description: Keep receipts for treatment, travel, and other related costs.

injury_photos.name: Relevant photographs
injury_photos.description: Keep dated photos of the scene or visible effects where appropriate.

injury_lost_income.name: Lost-income records
injury_lost_income.description: Keep employer or payment records that show missed income.

unknown.name: Supporting document
unknown.description: Keep a clear copy if it helps explain what happened or the loss.
